title: Hayati Pro Max Fresh Mint Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Fresh Mint delivers a cool, clean Mint flavour that’s simple, refreshing, and effective. It captures the crisp bite of fresh Mint leaves without any sweetness or fruit additions, offering a straightforward minty vape that’s ideal for all-day use. Crafted with nicotine salts for rapid absorption and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is best suited to MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod kits and vape pens. The 50VG/50PG blend provides discreet vapour and dependable flavour consistency with every puff. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
